rows.col_1: GET https://developer.api.autodesk.com/bim360/checklists/v1/containers/{containerId}/instances/{id}
user context required
data:read
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via a three-legged OAuth flow.
Each project is assigned a container that stores all the checklists for the project. To find the ID, see the Retrieve a Container ID tutorial.
The ID of the checklist.

Include additional data about the checklist’s items, sections, and attachments.
Possible values:
sections - sections
sections.items - items
sections.items.attachments - attachments
For example, include=sections,sections.items,items.attachments.

Specify which attributes you want to appear in the response. Separate multiple values with commas; for example, fields[instances]=createdAt,templateType. For more details, see JSON API Sparse Fieldsets.

Indicates whether the reponse should include the checklist’s instance-level signature.

If true, this endpoint will return the instance-level signatures object containing the requested checklist’s final signoff signature, along with all section signatures.
If false, this endpoint will not return the instance-level signatures object for the requested checklist, but will still return the section signatures.

The Object Storage Service (OSS) URN of a section signature image. This URN contains several substrings that can be used to obtain a signed S3 URL for downloading the image.
The example value of urn:adsk.objects:os.object:checklists.stg.us/aa0a9e77-e36c-492e-ace9-bb396338bf30 contains two key substrings:

checklists.prod.us (the bucket key)
aa0a9e77-e36c-492e-ace9-bb396338bf30 (the signature object key)

You can provide the bucket key and object key in a request with the Data Management API’s POST batchsigneds3download endpoint to generate a signed S3 download URL.
